description: Composición de residuos de construcción y demolición is a dataset listed in City of Buenos Aires open data portal (BA Data), an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio de Espacio Público e Higiene Urbana. Estudio de composición de los residuos de construcción y demolición que llegan a la Planta de Tratamiento de Áridos del Centro de Reciclaje de la Ciudad, realizado por el Observatorio de Higiene Urbana de la Ciudad (OHUCABA). Coverage: Ciudad de Buenos Aires. The portal files it under the publisher Ministerio de Espacio Público e Higiene Urbana. Its tags are OHUCABA, centro de reciclaje, demolicion, medio ambiente, remodelacion. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-06-22 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-caba-portal.
